title: The constraint equations of the joints in SymbolicSystem.Equations and GetFlatProgram
author: Claude-JG
description: Equations() gives the mass matrix and the forces; the constraints of ObjectJointUser (#3141) and their reaction forces C_q^T lambda are not in it, so the export of the equations of motion (RG12.51.5) misses them. Results algebraicEquations (of q and t) and reactionForces (of q, t and the algebraic coordinates), composed of the joint recordings and the marker kinematics as the connectors.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem.SymbolicSystem.Equations(algebraicEquations=True, reactionForces=True) gives the constraint equations of the joints and their reaction forces as expressions of q, t and the algebraic coordinates lambda_, and GetFlatProgram(results=[...]) writes them as code.
